content.description:
Ada Anvil provides advanced solutions for Web3 projects via a variety of services.

Multi-sig minting made easy! Elevate your projects minting experience with fast, secure and easy-to-use multi-sig minting.

A flexible set of tools built to scale with any project. Deliver fungible, and non-fungible rewards to your holders with our simple multi-sig staking platform.

An affordable solution for projects that need to airdrop assets to their holders! We can handle the snapshot, logic, and delivery of fungibles, and non-fungibles.

Anvil offers an easy solution for snapshots for your project. Get the data you need for data analytics, airdrops, and allow-lists.

Custom services are provided on a per request basis. Some popular custom requests offered are SDKs integrated to the blockchain, custom websites, and so much more.
